title: How Unbalanced Must a Latin Rectangle Be?
abstract: arXiv:2611.06003v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We view a $k\times n$ Latin rectangle as $n$ points in the grid $[n]^k$. Each symbol gives one point, whose coordinates are the columns it occupies. The rectangle is balanced when these points are pairwise equidistant in the $\ell_1$ metric. Its imbalance measures the distance from this ideal. We study the minimum imbalance from three sides. Constructively, we use a simulated annealing that moves symbols within rows and only penalises column clashes. Against the reference table of Voboril et al. (2025), it improves 33 of the 51 non-square values for $8\le n\le 13$, by up to 39.4%, and matches the rest. A cheap invariant, the row group, certifies that none of the 33 new rectangles is isotopic to rows of a group table, so the earlier column-swapping local search cannot reach any of them. Exactly, a computer-assisted branch and bound proves that the minimum imbalance of a $3\times 9$ rectangle is $56$. D\'iaz et al. found this value, but

translated_title: 拉丁矩形必须有多不平衡？
translated_abstract: 我们将一个 $k\times n$ 拉丁矩形视为网格 $[n]^k$ 中的 $n$ 个点。每个符号对应一个点，其坐标为该符号所占的列。当这些点在 $\ell_1$ 度量下两两等距时，称该矩形是平衡的，其不平衡度衡量了与这一理想状态的偏离程度。我们从三个方面研究最小不平衡度。在构造方面，我们使用一种模拟退火方法，该方法在行内移动符号，且仅对列冲突进行惩罚。与 Voboril 等人（2025）的参考表相比，该方法在 $8\le n\le 13$ 范围内的 51 个非方形值中改进了 33 个，改进幅度最高达 39.4%，其余值则保持持平。一个计算代价低廉的不变量——行群，证明了这 33 个新矩形中没有一个与群表的行同痕（isotopic），因此早期的列交换局部搜索无法到达其中任何一个。在精确证明方面，计算机辅助的分支定界法证明了 $3\times 9$ 矩形的最小不平衡度恰为 $56$。Díaz 等人曾找到这一数值，但……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文将拉丁矩形的平衡性问题转化为网格中点的 $\ell_1$ 等距问题，通过模拟退火方法将 33 个最小不平衡度上界最多改进 39.4%，并借助计算机辅助分支定界法首次精确证明 3×9 矩形的最小不平衡度为 56。
en_tdlr: This paper reformulates the balance of Latin rectangles as an $\ell_1$-equidistance problem for grid points, improving 33 upper bounds on minimum imbalance by up to 39.4% via simulated annealing and exactly proving that a 3×9 rectangle has minimum imbalance 56 through computer-assisted branch and bound.
